Static Ads Generator · using the library

The template is the blueprint. The rebuild follows it.

The 972-template library isn’t a mood board we glance at and ignore. Each template is a proven composition. So the rebuild reconstructs the chosen template’s skeleton faithfully — the same zones, the same device, the same reading order — and only then renders it crisply in the brand’s own voice. Not a pixel-for-pixel copy. Not a fresh invention. The same ad, wearing Trade With The Pros.

Left is the real template, pulled straight from the library. Right is the rebuild. You should be able to tell, instantly, which template each one came from.

Before / after phones

Fitness coach comparison — “$200 vs $50/mo programming”

KeptThe dark question banner, the Before / After labels, and the two diagonally-overlapping phones — an amateur artifact beside a professional one.

ReskinnedThe messy solo trade log vs a clean Trade With The Pros plan. Same device, new brand.

Big centered question

Legal firm — Morgan & Morgan “birth injury?”

KeptThe deep-blue field, the hanging “mobile” up top, the giant centered condensed question, the subhead, the two-logo lockup bar, and the fine print.

ReskinnedThe nursery mobile became dangling candlesticks; the co-brand lockup became Trade With The Pros + In-Person Centers.

iOS Notes testimonial

App testimonial — the native Notes screenshot

KeptThe iOS Notes chrome, the single yellow-highlighted line, a small artifact lower-left, and the hand-drawn red “This”.

ReskinnedA trader’s testimonial — and the photo became a clean P&L card, so no AI image is ever needed.

Us vs. them checklist

Razors — Harry’s “getting ripped off?”

KeptThe feature checklist with two columns, the value row with its curved arrow, the two-colour “are you…” headline, and two labelled cards.

ReskinnedRazors became online-course-vs-in-person; the brand’s orange became Trade With The Pros blue.

That’s the library doing its job.

The template decides the structure; the render finally executes it cleanly instead of letting an image model garble the type and the logo. Every pair here was checked by an independent pass that scored one thing: can you still tell which template this is? All four passed.
